scoring_justification: Full recompute (T1) infeasible: the DFT+DFPT+EPW+ShengBTE pipeline cannot be re-executed in the verifier sandbox. The checker performs a result-level consistency check comparing the agent-reported ZT values to the paper gold within tolerance.

outputs.description: Thermoelectric figure of merit ZT at 600 K for γ‑graphyne: p‑type (x‑direction) and n‑type (y‑direction).

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference ZT values for γ‑graphyne at 600 K (p‑type x‑direction and n‑type y‑direction) from the paper’s Table I.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper 'Thermoelectric properties of graphyne from first-principles calculations', Table I, rows for 600 K, x‑p and y‑n entries: ZT=1.48 and ZT=1.05. The paper abstract and main text round these to 1.5 and 1.0.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual numeric values reported in the paper’s table; they correspond to the paper’s maximum ZT claim and are used as the hidden gold.
